title: Oceanic Norwegian Sauerkraut Bowl
description: A funky and refreshing Norwegian dish featuring white sauerkraut and kombu cold extract, perfect for a solo dinner. This plant-based friendly bowl is a unique and healthy option.
instructions: Rinse the white sauerkraut in cold water and drain well.
In a small bowl, whisk together the kombu cold extract and apple cider vinegar.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked brown rice, grated carrots, and rehydrated norwegian seaweed.
Add the drained sauerkraut to the bowl and pour the kombu extract mixture over the top.
Drizzle the sesame oil over the sauerkraut and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Toss the mixture gently to combine.
Cover the bowl with a lid or plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the Oceanic Norwegian Sauerkraut Bowl chilled, garnished with additional norwegian seaweed if desired.
Store any leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
